description: Recognize books from one or more photos of a bookshelf; several photos become one collection (uses daily credits or BYOK)

cover_index.description: Zero-based index into images of the photo to use as the collection cover (default 0)

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded single photo (provide this OR image_url)

image_url.description: URL of a single bookshelf photo

images.description: Several photos of one bookshelf, saved as ONE collection (up to 4 with a user key). Each entry has image_url or image_base64. Use instead of image_url / image_base64, not with them. Prefer URLs: base64 photos over 4 MB in total do not fit in one request. Each photo uses one credit.

title.description: Optional title for the new collection

name: recognize_bookshelf
